title.zh: 卷二七 補列傳第十九 万俟普 劉豐 破六韓常 金祚 韋子粲
title.en: Volume 27 Biographies 19: Moqi Pu; Liu Feng; Poliuhan Chang; Jin Zuo; Wei Zican;
title.raw: 卷二七 補列傳第十九 万俟普 劉豐 破六韓常 金祚 韋子粲 Volume 27 Biographies 19: Moqi Pu; Liu Feng; Poliuhan Chang; Jin Zuo; Wei Zican;

sentences.zh: 万俟普 子 洛 可朱渾元 劉豐 破六韓常 金祚 韋子粲

translations.literal: Moqi Pu; son Luo; Kezhuhun Yuan; Liu Feng; Poliuhan Chang; Jin Zuo; Wei Zican
translations.idiomatic: Moqi Pu; his son Luo; Kezhuhun Yuan; Liu Feng; Poliuhan Chang; Jin Zuo; Wei Zican

sentences.zh: 万俟普，字普撥，太平人，其先匈奴之別種也。

translations.literal: Moqi Pu, styled Pubo, was a native of Taiping; his ancestors were a separate branch of the Xiongnu.
translations.idiomatic: Moqi Pu, styled Pubo, came from Taiping; his forebears were a separate branch of the Xiongnu.

sentences.zh: 雄果有武力。

translations.literal: Bold and resolute, he had martial strength.
translations.idiomatic: He was bold and resolute and possessed martial strength.

sentences.zh: 正光中，破六韓拔陵構逆，授普太尉。

translations.literal: In the Zhenguang era, Poliuhan Baling raised rebellion; Pu was appointed Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenguang era Poliuhan Baling raised rebellion; Pu was appointed grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 率部下降魏，授後將軍，第二領民酋長。

translations.literal: He led his tribe in surrender to Wei and was appointed General of the Rear Guard and second leader of the tribal chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: He led his tribe in surrender to Wei and was made general of the rear guard and second leader of the tribal chieftains.

sentences.zh: 高祖起義，普遠通誠款，高祖甚嘉之。

translations.literal: When Gao Huan raised the righteous standard, Pu sent pledges of loyalty from afar; Gao Huan greatly praised him.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan raised the righteous standard, Pu sent pledges of loyalty from afar; Gao Huan greatly praised him.

sentences.zh: 斛斯椿逼帝西出，授司空、秦州刺史，據覆靺城。

translations.literal: When Husu Chun forced the emperor westward, Pu was appointed Minister of Works and inspector of Qin Province, holding Fuche City.
translations.idiomatic: When Husu Chun forced the emperor westward, Pu was appointed minister of works and inspector of Qin Province, holding Fuche City.

sentences.zh: 高祖平夏州，普乃率其部落來奔，高祖躬自迎接，授普河西公。

translations.literal: When Gao Huan pacified Xia Province, Pu then led his tribe to come and submit; Gao Huan personally went out to receive him and appointed Pu Duke of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan pacified Xia Province, Pu led his tribe to submit; Gao Huan went out in person to receive him and made him duke of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 累遷太尉、朔州刺史，卒。

translations.literal: He rose in repeated promotions to Grand Mentor and inspector of Shuozhou, then died.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through repeated promotions to grand mentor and inspector of Shuozhou, then died.

sentences.zh: 子洛，字受洛干。

translations.literal: His son Luo, styled Shouluogan.
translations.idiomatic: His son Luo, styled Shouluogan.

sentences.zh: 豪壯有武藝，騎射過人，為鄉閭所伏。

translations.literal: Bold and stalwart, skilled in martial arts; his mounted archery surpassed others, and the village community respected him.
translations.idiomatic: Bold and stalwart, skilled in the martial arts; his mounted archery surpassed others, and the village community respected him.

sentences.zh: 拔陵反，隨父歸順，除顯武將軍。

translations.literal: When Baling rebelled, he followed his father in submitting; he was appointed Manifest Martial General.
translations.idiomatic: When Baling rebelled he followed his father in submitting and was appointed manifest martial general.

sentences.zh: 隨尒朱榮每有戰功，累遷汾州刺史、驃騎將軍。

translations.literal: Following Erzhu Rong he had battle merit in every engagement; he rose in successive promotions to inspector of Fenzhou and General of Agile Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Following Erzhu Rong he won merit in every battle; he rose in successive promotions to inspector of Fenzhou and general of agile cavalry.

sentences.zh: 及起義信都，遠送誠款，高祖嘉其父子俱至，甚優其禮。

translations.literal: When the righteous rising began at Xindu, he sent pledges of loyalty from afar; Gao Huan praised that father and son had both come and treated them with exceptional courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: When the righteous rising began at Xindu he sent pledges of loyalty from afar; Gao Huan praised that father and son had both come and treated them with exceptional courtesy.

sentences.zh: 除撫軍，兼靈州刺史。

translations.literal: He was appointed Pacification Army [commander] and concurrently inspector of Ling Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed to the Pacification Army and concurrently made inspector of Ling Province.

sentences.zh: 武帝入關，除左仆射。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu entered the passes, he was appointed Vice Director of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu entered the passes he was appointed left vice director.

sentences.zh: 天平中，隨父東歸，封建昌郡公，再遷領軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the Tianping era he followed his father east; he was enfeoffed Duke of Jianchang commandery and promoted again to Commander of the Guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tianping era he followed his father east; he was enfeoffed duke of Jianchang commandery and promoted again to commander of the guards.

sentences.zh: 與諸將圍獨孤如願於金墉，及河陰之戰，並有功。

translations.literal: With the generals he besieged Dugu Ruyuan at Jinyong; at the battle of Heyin he had merit as well.
translations.idiomatic: With the generals he besieged Dugu Ruyuan at Jinyong; at the battle of Heyin he had merit as well.

sentences.zh: 高祖以其父普尊老，特崇禮之，嘗親扶上馬。

translations.literal: Gao Huan, because his father Pu was honored as an elder, especially elevated his ritual treatment; he once personally helped him mount his horse.
translations.idiomatic: Because his father Pu was honored as an elder, Gao Huan especially elevated his ritual treatment; he once personally helped him mount his horse.

sentences.zh: 洛免冠稽首曰：「願出死力以報深恩。

translations.literal: Luo removed his cap and performed the forehead knock, saying: "I wish to give my utmost strength to repay your deep grace.
translations.idiomatic: Luo removed his cap and performed the forehead knock, saying: "I wish to give my utmost strength to repay your deep grace.

sentences.zh: 」及此役也，諸軍北渡橋，洛以一軍不動。

translations.literal: " And in this battle, when the armies crossed the bridge northward, Luo held one army motionless.
translations.idiomatic: " In this battle, when the armies crossed the bridge northward, Luo held one army motionless.

sentences.zh: 謂西人曰：「万俟受洛干在此，能來可來也！

translations.literal: He said to the westerners: "Moqi Shouluogan is here — if you can come, come!
translations.idiomatic: He said to the westerners: "Moqi Shouluogan is here — if you can come, come!

sentences.zh: 」西人畏而去。

translations.literal: " The westerners feared and departed.
translations.idiomatic: " The westerners feared him and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 高祖以雄壯，名其所營地為回洛城。

translations.literal: Gao Huan, because of his heroism and stature, named the place he camped Huiluo City.
translations.idiomatic: Because of his heroism and stature, Gao Huan named the place he camped Huiluo City.

sentences.zh: 洛慷慨有氣節，勇銳冠時，當世推為名將。

translations.literal: Luo was generous and had moral resolve; his courage and sharpness crowned the age; his contemporaries esteemed him a famous general.
translations.idiomatic: Luo was generous and high-minded; his courage and keenness crowned the age, and his contemporaries esteemed him a famous general.

sentences.zh: 興和初卒。

translations.literal: He died early in Xinghe.
translations.idiomatic: He died early in the Xinghe era.

sentences.zh: 可朱渾元，字道元。

translations.literal: Kezhuhun Yuan, styled Daoyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Kezhuhun Yuan, styled Daoyuan.

sentences.zh: 自云遼東人。

translations.literal: He himself said he was from Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: He himself said he was from Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 世為渠帥，魏時擁衆內附，曾祖護野肱終於懷朔鎮將，遂家焉。

translations.literal: For generations his family had been tribal chiefs; in Wei times they led their masses in submission; his great-grandfather Huyegu ended as general of Huaishuo garrison, and the family settled there.
translations.idiomatic: For generations his family had been tribal chiefs; in Wei times they led their followers in submission; his great-grandfather Huyegu died as general of Huaishuo garrison, and the family settled there.

sentences.zh: 元寬仁有武略，少與高祖相知。

translations.literal: Yuan was broad and benevolent, with military strategy; in youth he knew Gao Huan well.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan was broad-minded and benevolent, with military strategy; in youth he knew Gao Huan well.

sentences.zh: 北邊擾亂，遂將家屬赴定州，值鮮于修禮作亂，元擁衆屬焉。

translations.literal: When the north border was in turmoil, he led his household to go to Dingzhou; they encountered Xianyu Xiuli raising rebellion, and Yuan led his masses to join him.
translations.idiomatic: When the northern frontier was in turmoil he led his household to Dingzhou; they encountered Xianyu Xiuli raising rebellion, and Yuan led his followers to join him.

sentences.zh: 葛榮併並修禮，復以元為梁王。

translations.literal: Ge Rong swallowed up Xiuli, and again made Yuan Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Rong swallowed up Xiuli and again made Yuan prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 遂奔尒朱榮，以為別將，隸天光征關中，以功為渭州刺史。

translations.literal: He then fled to Erzhu Rong, who made him a separate commander; he was attached to Tian Guang's campaign into Guanzhong, and for merit was made inspector of Wei Province.
translations.idiomatic: He then fled to Erzhu Rong, who made him a separate commander; he was attached to Tian Guang's campaign into Guanzhong and, for merit, was made inspector of Wei Province.

sentences.zh: 侯莫陳悅之殺賀拔岳也，周文帝率岳所部還，共圖悅。

translations.literal: When Houmochen Yue killed Heba Yue, Yuwen Tai led Yue's troops back and together they plotted against Yue.
translations.idiomatic: When Houmochen Yue killed Heba Yue, Yuwen Tai led Yue's troops back and together they plotted against Yue.

sentences.zh: 元時助悅，悅走，元收其衆，入據秦州，為周攻圍，苦戰，結盟而罷。

translations.literal: At that time Yuan helped Yue; when Yue fled, Yuan gathered his troops, entered and held Qinzhou, was besieged by Zhou, fought bitterly, and made an alliance to cease.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Yuan helped Yue; when Yue fled, Yuan gathered his troops, entered and held Qinzhou, was besieged by Zhou forces, fought bitterly, and made an alliance to cease hostilities.

sentences.zh: 元既早被高祖知遇，兼其母兄在東，嘗有思歸之志，恒遣表疏，與高祖陰相往來。

translations.literal: Yuan had early been known and favored by Gao Huan; moreover his mother and elder brother were in the east; he always had thoughts of returning home, constantly sent memorials, and secretly corresponded with Gao Huan.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan had long been known and favored by Gao Huan; moreover his mother and elder brother were in the east; he always yearned to return, constantly sent memorials, and secretly corresponded with Gao Huan.

sentences.zh: 周文忌元智勇，知元懷貳，發兵攻之。

translations.literal: Yuwen Tai feared Yuan's wisdom and courage, knew Yuan was of two minds, and sent troops to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai feared Yuan's wisdom and courage, knew Yuan was of two minds, and sent troops to attack him.

sentences.zh: 元乃率所部，發自渭州，西北渡烏蘭津。

translations.literal: Yuan then led his division, setting out from Wei Province, and crossed Wulan ford northwestward.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan then led his division out from Wei Province and crossed Wulan ford to the northwest.

sentences.zh: 周文頻遣兵邀之，元戰必摧之。

translations.literal: Yuwen Tai repeatedly sent troops to intercept him; whenever Yuan fought he crushed them.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai repeatedly sent troops to intercept him; whenever Yuan fought he crushed them.

sentences.zh: 引軍歷河、源二州境，乃得東出。

translations.literal: He led his army through the territories of He and Yuan provinces, and only then got out eastward.
translations.idiomatic: He led his army through the territories of He and Yuan provinces and only then broke out eastward.

sentences.zh: 靈州刺史曹埿女婿劉豐與元深相交結，元因說豐以高祖英武非常，克成大業，豐自此便有委質之心，遂資遣元。

translations.literal: Inspector of Lingzhou Cao Qi had a son-in-law Liu Feng who was deeply connected with Yuan; Yuan therefore persuaded Feng that Gao Huan was extraordinarily heroic and would accomplish great enterprise; from then on Feng had the heart to submit his allegiance, and supplied Yuan for his journey.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Lingzhou Cao Qi had a son-in-law, Liu Feng, who was deeply connected with Yuan; Yuan therefore persuaded Feng that Gao Huan was extraordinarily heroic and would accomplish great enterprise; from then on Feng had the heart to pledge allegiance, and supplied Yuan for his journey.

sentences.zh: 元從靈州東北入雲州。

translations.literal: Yuan entered Yun Province from the northeast of Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan entered Yun Province from the northeast of Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 高祖聞其來也，遣平陽守高嵩持金環一枚以賜元，並運資糧，遠遣候接。

translations.literal: When Gao Huan heard he was coming, he sent Administrator of Pingyang Gao Song with a gold ring to bestow on Yuan, and shipped provisions, sending envoys far to meet him.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan heard he was coming, he sent the administrator of Pingyang, Gao Song, with a gold ring to bestow on Yuan, shipped provisions, and sent envoys far ahead to meet him.

sentences.zh: 元至晉陽，引見執手，賜帛千匹並奴婢田宅。

translations.literal: When Yuan reached Jinyang, he was received in audience and they clasped hands; he was given a thousand bolts of silk plus slaves, maidservants, fields and houses.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan reached Jinyang he was received in audience and they clasped hands; he was given a thousand bolts of silk together with slaves, maidservants, fields, and houses.

sentences.zh: 兄弟四人先在幷州者，進官爵。

translations.literal: His four brothers who were earlier in Bingzhou were promoted in rank and enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: His four brothers who were already in Bingzhou were promoted in rank and enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 元所部督將，皆賞以爵邑。

translations.literal: All the commanders and generals of Yuan's division were rewarded with ranks and fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: All the commanders and generals of Yuan's division were rewarded with ranks and fiefs.

sentences.zh: 封元縣公，除車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: Yuan was enfeoffed Duke of a county and appointed Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan was enfeoffed duke of a county and appointed grand general of chariots and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 討西魏儀同金祚、皇甫智達於東雍，擒之。

translations.literal: He attacked Western Wei yitong Jin Zuo and Huangfu Zhida at Dongyong and captured them.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Western Wei yitong Jin Zuo and Huangfu Zhida at Dongyong and captured them.

sentences.zh: 遷幷州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to inspector of Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to inspector of Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 又與諸將征伐，頻有克捷降下。

translations.literal: Again with the generals on campaigns, he had repeated victories in subduing foes.
translations.idiomatic: Again campaigning with the generals, he had repeated victories in subduing foes.

sentences.zh: 天保初，封扶風王。

translations.literal: Early in Tianbao, he was enfeoffed Prince of Fufeng.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tianbao he was enfeoffed prince of Fufeng.

sentences.zh: 頻從顯祖討山胡、茹茹，累有戰功。

translations.literal: He repeatedly followed Gao Yang in campaigns against the Shanhu and Ruru, with repeated battle merit.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly followed Gao Yang in campaigns against the Shanhu and Ruru and won repeated battle merit.

sentences.zh: 遷太師，薨。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Grand Preceptor and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to grand preceptor and died.

sentences.zh: 贈假黃鉞、太宰、錄尚書。

translations.literal: Posthumously given the yellow axe of authority, Grand Tutor, and Recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was given the yellow axe of authority, grand tutor, and recorder of the masters of writing.

sentences.zh: 元善於御衆，行軍用兵，務在持重，前後出征，未嘗負敗。

translations.literal: Yuan was skilled at governing troops; in marching and using troops he always aimed at steadiness; in front and rear expeditions he never suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan was skilled at governing troops; in marching and using troops he always aimed at steadiness; in expedition after expedition he never suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 及卒，朝廷深悼之。

translations.literal: When he died the court deeply mourned him.
translations.idiomatic: When he died the court deeply mourned him.

sentences.zh: 皇建初，配享世宗廟庭。

translations.literal: Early in Huangjian, he was granted joint sacrifice in Gao Cheng's temple hall.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Huangjian he was granted joint sacrifice in Gao Cheng's temple hall.

sentences.zh: 劉豐，字豐生，普樂人也。

translations.literal: Liu Feng, styled Fengsheng, was a native of Pule.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Feng, styled Fengsheng, came from Pule.

sentences.zh: 有雄姿壯氣，果毅絕人，有口辯，好說兵事。

translations.literal: He had heroic bearing and stalwart spirit, resolution surpassing others, was eloquent of speech, and loved to discuss military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He had heroic bearing and stalwart spirit, resolution surpassing others, was eloquent, and loved to discuss military affairs.

sentences.zh: 破六韓拔陵之亂，豐以守城之功，除普樂太守。

translations.literal: In Poliuhan Baling's rebellion, Feng for merit in holding the city was appointed Administrator of Pule.
translations.idiomatic: In Poliuhan Baling's rebellion, Feng for merit in holding the city was appointed administrator of Pule.

sentences.zh: 魏永安初，除靈州鎮城大都督。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yong'an of Wei, he was made metropolitan commandant defending the city of Ling Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yong'an of Wei, he was made metropolitan commandant defending the city of Ling Province.

sentences.zh: 周文授以衛大將軍，豐不受，乃遣攻圍，不克。

translations.literal: Yuwen Tai gave him the rank of Grand General of the Guard; Feng would not accept it, so Yuwen sent troops to besiege him but could not take the city.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai offered him the rank of grand general of the guard; Feng refused, and Yuwen sent troops to besiege him but could not take the city.

sentences.zh: 豐遠慕高祖威德，乃率戶數萬來奔。

translations.literal: Feng greatly admired Gao Huan's prestige and virtue and thereupon led several tens of thousands of households to come over.
translations.idiomatic: Feng had long admired Gao Huan's prestige and virtue; he thereupon led several tens of thousands of households to defect.

sentences.zh: 高祖上豐為平西將軍、南汾州刺史。

translations.literal: Gao Huan promoted Feng to General Who Pacifies the West and governor of Southern Fen Province.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan promoted Feng to general who pacifies the west and governor of Southern Fen Province.

sentences.zh: 遂與諸將征討，平定寇亂。

translations.literal: He then joined the generals on punitive campaigns and pacified bandit disorder.
translations.idiomatic: He then campaigned with the generals and pacified the bandit disorders.

sentences.zh: 又從高祖破周文於河陰，豐功居多，高祖執手嗟賞。

translations.literal: He again followed Gao Huan in defeating Yuwen Tai at Heyin; Feng's merit was greatest, and Gao Huan took his hand and sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Gao Huan in defeating Yuwen Tai at Heyin; Feng's merit stood first, and Gao Huan took his hand and sighed in admiration.

sentences.zh: 入為左衛將軍，出除殷州。

translations.literal: He entered court as left guard general and went out as governor of Yin Province.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as left guard general and went out as governor of Yin Province.

sentences.zh: 王思政據長社，世宗命豐與清河王岳攻之。

translations.literal: Wang Sizheng held Changshe; Gao Cheng ordered Feng and Prince of Qinghe Yue to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sizheng held Changshe; Gao Cheng ordered Feng and Prince of Qinghe Yue to attack him.

sentences.zh: 豐建水攻之策，遂遏洧水以灌之，水長，魚鱉皆遊焉。

translations.literal: Feng devised a plan of water assault and dammed the Wei River to flood the city; as the waters rose, fish and turtles swam there.
translations.idiomatic: Feng devised a water assault: they dammed the Wei River to flood the city, and as the waters rose, fish and turtles swam in the streets.

sentences.zh: 九月至四月，城將陷。

translations.literal: From the ninth month to the fourth month, the city was on the verge of falling.
translations.idiomatic: From the ninth month to the fourth month the city was on the verge of falling.

sentences.zh: 豐與行臺慕容紹宗見北有白氣同入船，忽有暴風從東北來，正晝昏暗，飛沙走礫，船纜忽絕，漂至城下。

translations.literal: Feng and mobile-office commissioner Murong Shaozong saw a white vapor in the north and entered a boat together. Suddenly a violent wind came from the northeast; at high noon it grew dark, sand flew and stones dashed; the boat cables snapped at once, and they drifted to the foot of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Feng and mobile-office commissioner Murong Shaozong saw a white vapor in the north and boarded a boat together. Suddenly a violent wind rose from the northeast; at high noon the sky went dark, sand flew and stones scoured the air, the mooring lines snapped, and the boat was driven to the foot of the city.

sentences.zh: 豐遊水向土山，為浪所激，不時至，西人釣之，並為敵人所害。

translations.literal: Feng swam toward an earthen hill but was driven by the waves and did not arrive in time; men of the west hooked him with poles, and both were killed by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Feng swam toward an earthen hill but was beaten by the waves and could not reach it in time; Western troops hooked him with poles, and both were killed by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 豐壯勇善戰，為諸將所推。

translations.literal: Feng was stalwart, brave, and skilled in battle, and was acclaimed by the generals.
translations.idiomatic: Feng was stalwart, brave, and skilled in battle, and the generals held him in high esteem.

sentences.zh: 死之日，朝野駭惋。

translations.literal: On the day he died, court and countryside alike were struck with dismay and lament.
translations.idiomatic: On the day he died, court and countryside alike were struck with dismay and grief.

sentences.zh: 贈大司馬、司徒公、尚書令，諡曰忠。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was given Grand Marshal, Duke of the Department of State Affairs, Director of the Masters of Writing, posthumous title Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was made grand marshal, duke of the department of state affairs, and director of the masters of writing, with the posthumous title Loyal.

sentences.zh: 子曄嗣。

translations.literal: His son Ye succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ye succeeded.

sentences.zh: 破六韓常，字保年，附化人，匈奴單于之裔也。

translations.literal: Poliuhan Chang, styled Baonian, was a man of Fuhua and a descendant of the Xiongnu Shanyu.
translations.idiomatic: Poliuhan Chang, styled Baonian, was a man of Fuhua and a descendant of the Xiongnu shanyu.

sentences.zh: 右谷蠡王潘六奚沒於魏，其子孫以潘六奚為氏，後人訛誤，以為破六韓。

translations.literal: Right kuuli prince Pan Liuxi perished in Wei; his descendants took Pan Liuxi as their clan name; later men garbled it into Poliuhan.
translations.idiomatic: The right kuuli prince Pan Liuxi perished in Wei; his descendants took Pan Liuxi as their clan name, and later men garbled it into Poliuhan.

sentences.zh: 世領部落，其父孔雀，世襲酋長。

translations.literal: For generations they led their tribe; his father Kongque inherited the chieftaincy in succession.
translations.idiomatic: For generations they led their tribe; his father Kongque had inherited the chieftaincy in turn.

sentences.zh: 孔雀少驍勇。

translations.literal: Kongque was from youth fierce and brave.
translations.idiomatic: Kongque was fierce and brave from youth.

sentences.zh: 時宗人拔陵為亂，以孔雀為大都督、司徒、平南王。

translations.literal: At that time their clansman Baling raised rebellion and made Kongque grand commander of the north, Director of State Affairs, and Prince Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: At that time their clansman Baling raised rebellion and made Kongque grand commander of the north, director of state affairs, and prince who pacifies the south.

sentences.zh: 孔雀率部下一萬人降於尒朱榮，詔加平北將軍、第一領民酋長，卒。

translations.literal: Kongque led his division, ten thousand men, and submitted to Erzhu Rong; an edict added General Who Pacifies the North and chief of the first tribally enrolled division; he died.
translations.idiomatic: Kongque led his division of ten thousand men and submitted to Erzhu Rong; an edict added general who pacifies the north and chief of the first tribally enrolled division, and he died.

sentences.zh: 常沈敏有膽略，善騎射，累遷平西將軍。

translations.literal: Chang was deep, keen, and had courage and resource; skilled in mounted archery; he rose in succession to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: Chang was deep and keen, bold and resourceful, and skilled in mounted archery; he rose in succession to general who pacifies the west.

sentences.zh: 高祖起義，常為附化守，與万俟受洛干東歸，高祖嘉之，上為撫軍。

translations.literal: When Gao Huan raised the righteous rising, Chang was defender of Fuhua; he returned east with Moqi Shouluogan; Gao Huan praised this and promoted him to Military Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan raised the righteous rising, Chang was defender of Fuhua; he returned east with Moqi Shouluogan. Gao Huan praised this and promoted him to military inspector.

sentences.zh: 與諸將征討，又從高祖攻擊諸寇，累遷車騎大將軍、開府，封平陽公，除洛州刺史。

translations.literal: With the generals on punitive campaigns he again followed Gao Huan in attacking the various bandits, rising in succession to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Opener of a Government Office, Duke of Pingyang, and governor of Luo Province.
translations.idiomatic: On punitive campaigns with the generals he again followed Gao Huan against the bandits, rising in succession to grand general of chariots and cavalry, opener of a government office, duke of Pingyang, and governor of Luo Province.

sentences.zh: 常啟世宗曰：「常自鎮河陽以來，頻出關口，太谷二道，北荊已北，洛州已南，所有要害，頗所知悉。

translations.literal: Chang addressed Gao Cheng, saying: "Since I have garrisoned Heyang, I have repeatedly sallied through the passes. Of the two routes through Taiyu, north of Northern Jing and south of Luo Province, I know well all the strategic points."
translations.idiomatic: Chang addressed Gao Cheng, saying, "Since I garrisoned Heyang I have repeatedly sallied through the passes. Of the two routes through Taiyu, north of Northern Jing and south of Luo Province, I know every strategic point."

sentences.zh: 而太谷南口去荊路逾一百，經赤工阪，是賊往還東西大道，中間曠絕一百五十里，賊之糧饢，唯經此路。

translations.literal: "Yet the southern mouth of Taiyu lies more than a hundred li from the Jing route, passes Chigong Slope, and is the bandits' chief east-west thoroughfare. In the middle lies open country of a hundred and fifty li; the bandits' grain and fodder must come only by this road."
translations.idiomatic: "Yet the southern mouth of Taiyu lies more than a hundred li from the Jing route, passes Chigong Slope, and is the bandits' chief east-west thoroughfare. Between them lies open country a hundred and fifty li across; the bandits' grain and fodder must come only by this road."

sentences.zh: 愚謂於彼選形勝之處，營築城戍，安置士馬，截其遠還，自然不能更有行送。

translations.literal: "I humbly propose selecting a place of natural advantage there, building garrison walls, stationing troops and horses, and cutting off their long supply line — then naturally they could no longer send convoys."
translations.idiomatic: "I humbly propose that we choose a place of natural advantage there, build garrison walls, station troops and horses, and cut their long supply line — then naturally they could no longer send convoys."

sentences.zh: 」世宗納其計，遣大司馬斛律金等築楊志、百家、呼延三鎮。

translations.literal: Gao Cheng adopted his plan and sent Grand Marshal Hulü Jin and others to build the three garrisons of Yangzhi, Baijia, and Huyan.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Cheng adopted his plan and sent Grand Marshal Hulü Jin and others to build the three garrisons of Yangzhi, Baijia, and Huyan.

sentences.zh: 常秩滿，還晉陽，拜太保、滄州刺史，卒。

translations.literal: When Chang's term expired he returned to Jinyang, was made Grand Mentor and governor of Cang Province, and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Chang's term expired he returned to Jinyang, was made grand mentor and governor of Cang Province, and died.

sentences.zh: 贈尚書令、司徒公、太傅、第一領民酋長，假王，諡曰忠武。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was given Director of the Masters of Writing, Duke of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Tutor, chief of the first tribally enrolled division, prince in title, posthumous title Zhongwu.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was made director of the masters of writing, duke of the department of state affairs, grand tutor, and chief of the first tribally enrolled division, with princely rank in title and the posthumous title Loyal and Martial.

sentences.zh: 金祚，字神敬，安定人也。

translations.literal: Jin Zuo, styled Shenjing, was a native of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Zuo, styled Shenjing, was a native of Anding.

sentences.zh: 性驍雄，尚氣任俠。

translations.literal: By nature he was fierce and heroic and prized spirit and chivalry.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was fierce and heroic and prized spirit and chivalry.

sentences.zh: 魏正光中，隴右賊起，詔雍州刺史元猛討之，召募狼家，以為軍導，祚應選。

translations.literal: In Zhenguang of Wei, bandits rose in Longyou; an edict ordered Governor of Yong Province Yuan Meng to suppress them and recruited men of Langjia as army guides; Zuo answered the call.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenguang of Wei, bandits rose in Longyou; an edict ordered Governor of Yong Province Yuan Meng to suppress them and recruited Langjia men as army guides; Zuo answered the call.

sentences.zh: 以軍功累遷龍驤將軍、靈州刺史。

translations.literal: For military merit he rose in succession to General of Soaring Dragon and governor of Ling Province.
translations.idiomatic: For military merit he rose in succession to general of soaring dragon and governor of Ling Province.

sentences.zh: 高祖舉義，尒朱天光率關右之衆與仲遠等北抗義師。

translations.literal: When Gao Huan raised the righteous rising, Erzhu Tianzhong led the forces of Guanxi and, with Zhongyuan and others, resisted the righteous army in the north.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan raised the righteous rising, Erzhu Tianzhong led the forces of Guanxi and, with Erzhu Zhongyuan and others, resisted the righteous army in the north.

sentences.zh: 天光留祚東秦，總督三州，鎮靜二州。

translations.literal: Tianzhong left Zuo in Eastern Qin, with overall command of three provinces and responsibility for pacifying two provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzhong left Zuo in Eastern Qin with overall command of three provinces and charge of pacifying two.

sentences.zh: 天光敗，歸高祖，除車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: When Tianzhong was defeated, Zuo submitted to Gao Huan and was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianzhong was defeated, Zuo submitted to Gao Huan and was made grand general of chariots and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 邙山之戰，以大都督從破西軍。

translations.literal: At the battle of Mount Mang, as grand commander he followed in breaking the Western army.
translations.idiomatic: At the battle of Mount Mang he followed as grand commander in breaking the Western army.

sentences.zh: 祚除華州刺史，加開府儀同三司，別封臨濟縣子，卒。

translations.literal: Zuo was made governor of Hua Province, with added opener of a government office equal in insignia to three masters of ceremonies, and was separately enfeoffed as Viscount of Linji county; he died.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo was made governor of Hua Province, with added opener of a government office equal in insignia to three masters of ceremonies, and was separately enfeoffed viscount of Linji county; he died.

sentences.zh: 贈司空。

translations.literal: Posthumously he was given Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 韋子粲，字暉茂，京兆人。

translations.literal: Wei Zican, styled Huimao, was a native of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zican, styled Huimao, was a native of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 曾祖閬，魏咸陽守。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Lang was Wei administrator of Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Lang was Wei administrator of Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 父雋，都水使者。

translations.literal: His father Juan was commissioner of waterways.
translations.idiomatic: His father Juan was commissioner of waterways.

sentences.zh: 子粲仕郡功曹史，累遷為大行臺郎中，從尒朱天光平關右。

translations.literal: Zican served as merit clerk of the commandery and rose in succession to gentleman of the great mobile headquarters, following Erzhu Tianzhong in pacifying Guanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zican served as the commandery merit clerk and rose in succession to gentleman of the great mobile headquarters, following Erzhu Tianzhong in pacifying Guanxi.

sentences.zh: 孝武入關，以為南汾州刺史。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu entered Guanzhong, Zican was made governor of Southern Fen Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu entered Guanzhong, Zican was made governor of Southern Fen Province.

sentences.zh: 神武命將出討，城陷，子弟俱破獲，送晉陽，蒙放免。

translations.literal: Gao Huan ordered generals out to attack; the city fell, and sons and younger brothers were all captured and sent to Jinyang, where they were spared and released.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan ordered generals out to attack; the city fell, and sons and younger brothers were all captured and sent to Jinyang, where they were spared and released.

sentences.zh: 以粲為幷州長史，累遷豫州刺史，卒。

translations.literal: Zican was made chief clerk of Bing Province and rose in succession to governor of Yu Province; he died.
translations.idiomatic: Zican was made chief clerk of Bing Province and rose in succession to governor of Yu Province; he died.

sentences.zh: 初，子粲兄弟十三人，子侄親屬，闔門百口悉在西魏。

translations.literal: At first Zican had thirteen brothers, and with sons, nephews, and kin of the whole gate a hundred mouths all were in Western Wei.
translations.idiomatic: At first Zican had thirteen brothers; with sons, nephews, and kin, the whole gate counted a hundred mouths, all in Western Wei.

sentences.zh: 以子粲陷城不能死難，多致誅滅，歸國獲存，唯與弟道諧二人而已。

translations.literal: Because Zican, when the city fell, could not die in loyalty, many were put to death; after returning to the state only he and his younger brother Dao Xie survived.
translations.idiomatic: Because Zican did not die when the city fell, many of his kin were put to death; after he returned to the Northern Qi state, only he and his younger brother Dao Xie survived.

sentences.zh: 諧與粲俱入國。

translations.literal: Xie entered the state together with Zican.
translations.idiomatic: Xie had entered the state together with Zican.

sentences.zh: 粲富貴之後，遂特棄道諧，令其異居，所得廩祿，略不相及，其不顧恩義如此。

translations.literal: After Zican grew rich and noble, he then deliberately cast off Dao Xie, made him live apart, and in grain and salary scarcely shared with him — such was his disregard for kindness and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: After Zican grew rich and noble, he deliberately cast off Dao Xie, made him live apart, and scarcely shared his grain and salary with him — such was his disregard for kindness and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 全文以中華書局、一九七二年十一月、第一版為本校。

translations.literal: The full text has been collated against the Zhonghua Shuju first edition of the Book of Northern Qi, November 1972.
translations.idiomatic: The full text has been collated against the Zhonghua Shuju first edition of the Book of Northern Qi, November 1972.
